Angler | NPCs | npc fishing town water | Eight-frame beat: wind up, cast, line settles, wait, rod jerks on the bite, two reels, fish held up. Bobber and splash sit at a fixed water point so the strike reads as a catch.
Pond Frog | Animals | animal pond nature | Squat green hopper — 5 states / 17 frames: resting idle, four-frame hop, throat-puffing croak, hurt and squash death.
